doc.brief: Base class for widgets which visualize an adjustment.
doc.md:
Base class for widgets which visualize an adjustment.

Widgets that are derived from `GtkRange` include
[`Scale`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Scale) and [`Scrollbar`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Scrollbar).

Apart from signals for monitoring the parameters of the adjustment,
`GtkRange` provides properties and methods for setting a
“fill level” on range widgets. See [`Range.set_fill_level()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Range#method:set_fill_level).

# Shortcuts and Gestures

The `GtkRange` slider is draggable. Holding the <kbd>Shift</kbd> key while
dragging, or initiating the drag with a long-press will enable the
fine-tuning mode.

set_adjustment.brief: Sets the adjustment to be used as the “model” object for the `GtkRange`
set_adjustment.md:
Sets the adjustment to be used as the “model” object for the `GtkRange`

The adjustment indicates the current range value, the minimum and
maximum range values, the step/page increments used for keybindings
and scrolling, and the page size.

The page size is normally 0 for `GtkScale` and nonzero for `GtkScrollbar`,
and indicates the size of the visible area of the widget being scrolled.
The page size affects the size of the scrollbar slider.

set_fill_level.brief: Set the new position of the fill level indicator.
set_fill_level.md:
Set the new position of the fill level indicator.

The “fill level” is probably best described by its most prominent
use case, which is an indicator for the amount of pre-buffering in
a streaming media player. In that use case, the value of the range
would indicate the current play position, and the fill level would
be the position up to which the file/stream has been downloaded.

This amount of prebuffering can be displayed on the range’s trough
and is themeable separately from the trough. To enable fill level
display, use [`Range.set_show_fill_level()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Range#method:set_show_fill_level). The range defaults
to not showing the fill level.

Additionally, it’s possible to restrict the range’s slider position
to values which are smaller than the fill level. This is controlled
by [`Range.set_restrict_to_fill_level()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Range#method:set_restrict_to_fill_level) and is by default
enabled.

set_flippable.brief: Sets whether the `GtkRange` respects text direction.
set_flippable.md:
Sets whether the `GtkRange` respects text direction.

If a range is flippable, it will switch its direction
if it is horizontal and its direction is %GTK_TEXT_DIR_RTL.

See [`Widget.get_direction()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#method:get_direction).

set_increments.brief: Sets the step and page sizes for the range.
set_increments.md:
Sets the step and page sizes for the range.

The step size is used when the user clicks the `GtkScrollbar`
arrows or moves a `GtkScale` via arrow keys. The page size
is used for example when moving via Page Up or Page Down keys.

set_inverted.brief: Sets whether to invert the range.
set_inverted.md:
Sets whether to invert the range.

Ranges normally move from lower to higher values as the
slider moves from top to bottom or left to right. Inverted
ranges have higher values at the top or on the right rather
than on the bottom or left.

set_range.brief: Sets the allowable values in the `GtkRange`.
set_range.md:
Sets the allowable values in the `GtkRange`.

The range value is clamped to be between `min` and `max`.
(If the range has a non-zero page size, it is clamped
between `min` and `max` - page-size.)

set_restrict_to_fill_level.brief: Sets whether the slider is restricted to the fill level.
set_restrict_to_fill_level.md:
Sets whether the slider is restricted to the fill level.

See [`Range.set_fill_level()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Range#method:set_fill_level) for a general description
of the fill level concept.

set_round_digits.md:

See [`Range::change-value`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Range#event:change-value).

set_show_fill_level.brief: Sets whether a graphical fill level is show on the trough.
set_show_fill_level.md:
Sets whether a graphical fill level is show on the trough.

See [`Range.set_fill_level()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Range#method:set_fill_level) for a general description

set_slider_size_fixed.brief: Sets whether the range’s slider has a fixed size, or a size that depends on its adjustment’s page size.
set_slider_size_fixed.md:
Sets whether the range’s slider has a fixed size, or a size that

This function is useful mainly for `GtkRange` subclasses.

set_value.brief: Sets the current value of the range.
set_value.md:
Sets the current value of the range.

If the value is outside the minimum or maximum range values,
it will be clamped to fit inside them. The range emits the
[`Range::value-changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Range#event:value-changed) signal if the value changes.

adjust-bounds.brief: Emitted before clamping a value, to give the application a chance to adjust the bounds.
adjust-bounds.md:
Emitted before clamping a value, to give the application a
chance to adjust the bounds.

change-value.brief: Emitted when a scroll action is performed on a range.
change-value.md:
Emitted when a scroll action is performed on a range.

It allows an application to determine the type of scroll event
that occurred and the resultant new value. The application can
handle the event itself and return `TRUE` to prevent further
processing. Or, by returning `FALSE`, it can pass the event to
other handlers until the default GTK handler is reached.

The value parameter is unrounded. An application that overrides
the ::change-value signal is responsible for clamping the value
to the desired number of decimal digits; the default GTK
handler clamps the value based on [`Range:round-digits`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Range#property:round-digits).

move-slider.brief: Virtual function that moves the slider.
move-slider.md:
Virtual function that moves the slider.

Used for keybindings.

value-changed.brief: Emitted when the range value changes.
value-changed.md: Emitted when the range value changes.
